authority: Package brief VESSELS (owner, 18 November 2026: "let's get the vascularity right, especially with the cerebral veins and etc. and for all other items as well"): exactly the BodyParts3D vessel parts may be downloaded from the BodyParts3D site, with file ids, names and the licence recorded; nothing downloaded is executed.
method: HTTP range requests against the official archive (serial, 1.5 s apart, no retries): HEAD for identity (ETag and size must equal the recorded ones), the end of central directory, the central directory, then each member's local header and compressed bytes; raw-deflate decompressed; ZIP CRC32 and uncompressed byte count must match the central directory; then sha256. The element list isa_element_parts.txt was fetched whole to name the members.
header_checks: File ID equals element id; Compatibility version 4.0 where the member's header states one (FJ1664, FJ1665 and FJ1719 leave name, concept and compatibility blank in the archive itself); parsed bounds within 0.13 mm of the header Bounds(mm); registration against the game's brain: median distance of a cortical branch's vertices to the nearest brain vertex 0.8 to 4.4 mm
